  "memo":"R02 holds: the device links three accounts. Its association with this account is too recent for the household exception. Shared household use remains plausible, while coordinated identities are possible but unproven. With no completed check, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for issuer authentication and identity verification. An id_check is the only required check.
